user.title: Quatt Heat Pump Configuration
user.description: Configure your Quatt heat pump data range and sensor entities.

data.temp_entities: Outside temperature sensor(s) — the first available one is used

gas.title: Gas Analysis (Optional)
gas.description: Configure gas consumption analysis to compare with heat pump performance. Use the period BEFORE your heat pump was installed.

options.title: Additional Options
options.description: Configure sensors and heating curve. The solar panel sensor can be any sensor that reports current power in Watts (W) — e.g. SolarEdge, Enphase, Huawei, SMA, or a template sensor. Leave empty if you have no solar panels.

data.indoor_temp_entity: Indoor temperature sensor (°C, for solar gain calibration)
data.sound_level_enabled: Enable sound level compensation (limits heat pump power via CiC sound level)
data.sound_level_max_day: Maximum sound level during the day
data.sound_night_start_hour: Night start hour (0–23, HA local time, e.g. 23)
data.sound_night_end_hour: Night end hour (0–23, HA local time, e.g. 7)
data.ch_max_water_enabled: Enable supply temperature control (writes max. supply temp to Quatt)
data.supply_temp_entity: Supply temperature sensor (°C) — reference for the advice

error.invalid_date_range: End date must be after start date
error.gas_entity_required: Gas entity is required when gas analysis is enabled

init.title: Update Configuration
init.description: The solar panel sensor can be any sensor that reports current power in Watts (W). Leave empty if you have no solar panels.

data.indoor_temp_entity: Indoor temperature sensor (°C, for solar gain calibration)
data.control_setpoint_entity: Thermostat control setpoint sensor (°C) — leave empty for auto-detection
data.room_setpoint_entity: Thermostat room setpoint sensor (°C) — leave empty for auto-detection
data.room_setpoint_fallback: Fallback room setpoint (°C) — used only when the thermostat provides none
data.cop_entity: COP sensor — leave empty for auto-detection
data.performance_baseline_date: Change marker date (YYYY-MM-DD) — freezes the efficiency norm on everything before it; empty = last 30 heating days
data.quatt_cloud_enabled: Use Quatt cloud API — off = local only (recorder + own stores). The built-up history is kept; only new hourly detail stops. Best if you have a second local source such as OpenQuatt.
data.sound_level_enabled: Enable sound level compensation (limits heat pump power via CiC sound level)
data.sound_level_max_day: Maximum sound level during the day
data.sound_night_start_hour: Night start hour (0–23, HA local time, e.g. 23)
data.sound_night_end_hour: Night end hour (0–23, HA local time, e.g. 7)
data.ch_max_water_enabled: Enable supply temperature control (writes max. supply temp to Quatt)
data.comfort_floor_temp: Comfort floor (°C) — lowest acceptable indoor temperature; the reference for coast time and stored heat, not the target temperature
data.eos_throttle_entity: External throttle entity (optional) — periods where an external controller caps the heat pump are excluded from the COP and heat-loss analysis; leave empty to disable
data.temp_entities: Outside temperature sensor(s) — the first available one is used
data.supply_temp_entity: Supply temperature sensor (°C) — reference for the advice
data.power_input_entity: Electrical power input sensor (W) — for COP calculation
data.boiler_heat_entity: Gas boiler heat output sensor (W) — for gas detection

run_analysis.name: Run Warmteanalyse
run_analysis.description: Runs the full analysis pipeline: fetches data, calculates heating curves, COP, and heat loss.

update_dashboard.name: Restore dashboard
update_dashboard.description: Overwrites the Quatt Warmteanalyse dashboard with the version shipped by the integration. Any changes you made to that dashboard are lost.

dashboard_update_available.title: New version of the Quatt Warmteanalyse dashboard

init.title: Dashboard update available
init.description:
This update ships an improved dashboard, but yours differs from the version the integration last wrote — so it was left untouched.

Choose what should happen. Either way this notice will not come back for this version.

menu_options.update: Take the new dashboard (my own changes to it are lost)
menu_options.keep: Keep my dashboard and stop asking
